ratings.rationale: Corporate lawyer vs fintech Payment Product Manager — entirely different careers, no product/payments/fintech skills.
Senior interventional cardiologist vs mobile games QA tester — completely different professional fields.
Junior nurse with no SQL, BI, or analytics experience vs Data Analyst role — entirely different field.
Senior English teacher vs Senior AI/ML Engineer requiring Python/Kubernetes/Neo4j — totally different careers.
Junior nurse vs Junior Manual QA (Postman, REST API, Jira) — different field, no testing/IT background.
Junior nurse vs Senior .NET Developer — completely unrelated careers and skills.
Junior nurse vs Product Marketing Manager (Tableau, Amplitude, A/B testing) — different field entirely.
IT recruiter vs Senior Manual QA — different professional family, no testing experience.
Growth marketing manager vs Vue Frontend Developer — totally different careers, no JS/Vue/TS coding.
IT recruiter vs Android Team Lead (Kotlin/Java) — entirely different careers, no mobile development.
Security engineer vs Tech Lead .NET — different role family, no C#/.NET/architecture leadership; only Git/Jira overlap.
Mid data analyst vs Senior PM for hardware intercoms — different role family, no PM/hardware/B2B intercom experience.
Fullstack JS/Java engineer vs Senior C# backend — no C#/.NET/PostgreSQL/Kafka stack; different ecosystem despite backend overlap.
Fullstack JS/Java SWE vs Senior Data Scientist (Python/ML/DL/Speech) — different role family, no ML/Python/DL experience.
Junior DevOps vs Middle Fullstack (React/Node/TS) — different role family, no React/Node/TypeScript dev experience.
Senior QA automation vs Middle Data Engineer — different family; only SQL/Python overlap, no ETL/warehousing/cloud DE work.
Senior accountant vs SQL/Data Engineer — different field; only Excel/Power BI superficial overlap, no SQL/Python pipelines.
Senior automation QA vs Mobile Games QA — same QA family but no Android/iOS/Appium-game-context; senior overshoots junior role.
Eng Manager vs PM/PO in energy (EMS/BESS/PV) — adjacent management family, has Agile/Jira but no PO ownership or energy domain.
Senior Android vs Senior iOS (Swift/SwiftUI/Web3) — adjacent mobile family but completely different stack and no crypto/Web3.
Senior Data Engineer vs Data Analyst (credit risk/banking) — adjacent data family, SQL/Python overlap but no credit risk/portfolio analytics.
Security engineer vs Middle DevOps — adjacent infra-family, has AWS/Linux/Git/CI but lacks K8s/Helm/Prometheus/Ansible depth.
Senior automation QA vs Mobile Games QA — same QA family but no mobile-game testing specifics; over-leveled for tester role.
Fullstack JS/Java SWE vs Fullstack Vue/PHP/Laravel — same fullstack family but completely different stack; no Vue/PHP/Laravel.
Junior .NET dev vs Trainee .NET Azure — C#/.NET/SQL/Git match but over-leveled (junior on trainee) and no Azure experience.
Mid React FE vs Senior Fullstack/AI Adoption Lead — React match but missing Node.js depth, senior level, and AI tooling leadership.
Senior PM with A/B testing, funnels, unit econ, Amplitude — matches D2C e-commerce PM; domain shift from fintech/energy is minor.
Mid growth marketer with AppsFlyer/Adjust/Amplitude/attribution/A/B testing — strong fit for Marketing Ops; C1 English meets req.
Senior Data Engineer with SQL/ETL/dbt/warehousing — solid fit for DE/ETL/BI role; only Power BI/MS SQL not explicit.
Mid data analyst with SQL/Amplitude/Tableau/product analytics, B2 English, 3+ yrs — solid fit for Data Analyst (consulting).
